name: crc_pilot
description: SLM capability ladder for colorectal-cancer drug-efficacy work: knowledge -> extraction -> computation -> structured summarization -> tool calls, each in EN and IT. Built to compare model families and quantizations of the same family per tier.

tasks.name: mcq_en
tasks.description: tier 1 EN: CRC drug/biomarker knowledge (hand-written, expert review pending)

tasks.name: mcq_it
tasks.description: tier 1 IT: parallel translations of mcq_en (pair: tags)

tasks.name: extract_en
tasks.description: tier 2 EN: extract one number from a synthetic trial abstract

tasks.name: extract_it
tasks.description: tier 2 IT: parallel abstracts (decimal point enforced in prompt)

tasks.name: compute_en
tasks.description: tier 3 EN: derive risk difference / NNT / pooled ORR

tasks.name: summary_en
tasks.description: tier 4 EN: abstract -> fixed-schema JSON, scored by ./checker.py:score_summary

tasks.name: summary_it
tasks.description: tier 4 IT: parallel (JSON keys stay English)

tasks.name: tool_en
tasks.description: tier 5 EN: emit an execute_python tool call, scored by ./checker.py:score_tool_call

tasks.name: mcq_hard_en
tasks.description: hard tier 1 EN: trial attribution, metabolites, fine pharmacology (expert review pending)

tasks.name: extract_hard_en
tasks.description: hard tier 2 EN: two studies + subgroup rows; disambiguate study, arm and subgroup

tasks.name: summary_hard_en
tasks.description: hard tier 4 EN: schema adds derived field orr_absolute_difference_pct

tasks.name: tool_hard_en
tasks.description: hard tier 5 EN: emitted code is EXECUTED against the table; printed result must match

meta.review_status: DRAFT v0.2 — tier-1 facts (base + hard) and IT phrasing pending domain-expert review
meta.exec_warning: tool_hard_* checkers execute model-generated Python in a subprocess (10s timeout)
